verdict.rationale: Simular documents an official Python SDK alongside its `POST /v1/agents/message` HTTPS API for driving Sai from your own code [simular-docs-6][simular-docs-1]. It also ships a first-party `simulang-js` library and the standalone simulang CLI [simular-docs-2], so developers have official SDKs to build against. Missing for 10: SDK reference docs or usage depth beyond a one-line mention, a published OpenAPI spec (all probe paths returned 404), SDKs for languages beyond Python and JS, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the SDKs.
